outlets.name: IGN Middle East
outlets.press_policy_notes: IGN Middle East (the 'IGN Arabia' edition) is operated by T-Break. T-Break contact page (read 2026-11-02): editor@tbreak.com for story tips and news; product review enquiries and sample requests go to the same address with 'Review' in the subject. Sponsorships and media enquiries (sales@tbreak.com) are a commercial route: do not use for editorial pitches. No separate IGN Middle East editorial address is published. Content is in Arabic and English.
outlets.audience_note: Arabic and English games coverage for the Middle East; reviews mostly mainstream titles.
outlets.notes: Press Batch 003 (owner request: IGN Arabia). me.ign.com blocks our fetch tools, so the site itself was not read; contact route comes from tbreak.com. Evidence is the OpenCritic outlet listing (316 reviews, mostly mainstream), not a comparable-game article. Verify the address before sending.
